"""Random valid fabric/profile generator following PROTOCOL.md."""
import random, math

def period(T,S,Q):
    m=Q*S
    return m//math.gcd(T,m)

def gen_profile(rng, K=None):
    K = K or rng.randint(1,6)
    jitter=[rng.randint(0,50) for _ in range(K)]
    nmeas=rng.randint(0,8)
    meas=[]
    # build a random spanning structure so the graph is connected
    for i in range(1,K):
        a=rng.randrange(i); b=i
        L=rng.randint(-20,20); U=L+rng.randint(0,20)
        meas.append([a,b,L,U])
    for _ in range(nmeas):
        a=rng.randrange(K); b=rng.randrange(K)
        if a==b: continue
        L=rng.randint(-30,30); U=L+rng.randint(0,30)
        meas.append([a,b,L,U])
    rng.shuffle(meas)
    return {'groups':K,'jitter_ps':jitter,'measurements':meas}

def gen_fabric(rng, n=None, K=1, P=None):
    N = n or rng.randint(1,5)
    T = rng.choice([1,5,10,20,50,100])
    Q = rng.randint(1,3)
    S = rng.choice([1,3,7,20,50,100,137])
    # P must satisfy P*T % (Q*S)==0 and P<=512
    P = period(T,S,Q)
    while P > 64:
        T = rng.choice([1,5,10,20,50,100]); S = rng.choice([1,3,7,20,50,100]); Q = rng.randint(1,3)
        P = period(T,S,Q)
    O = rng.randrange(S)
    # groups per (node,slot)
    groups = {}
    for i in range(N):
        for slot in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
            groups[(i,slot)] = rng.randrange(K)
    slots = sorted(set(groups))
    # links
    nlinks = rng.randint(0, min(6, N*2))
    links=[]; used_ports=set()
    for _ in range(nlinks):
        a=rng.randrange(N); b=rng.randrange(N)
        if a==b: continue
        sa = rng.choice([s for (n,s) in slots if n==a]) if any(n==a for (n,s) in slots) else 0
        sb = rng.choice([s for (n,s) in slots if n==b]) if any(n==b for (n,s) in slots) else 0
        if (a,sa) in used_ports or (b,sb) in used_ports: continue
        used_ports.add((a,sa)); used_ports.add((b,sb))
        links.append({'ends':[[a,sa,groups[(a,sa)]],[b,sb,groups[(b,sb)]]],
                      'delay_ns':[rng.randint(1,4*T), rng.randint(1,4*T)],
                      'defer_rounds':[rng.randint(0,3),rng.randint(0,3)]})
    # slices: partition the links into slices respecting port constraints
    nsl = rng.randint(1,3)
    slices=[[] for _ in range(nsl)]
    ports_per_slice=[set() for _ in range(nsl)]
    for i,l in enumerate(links):
        placed=False
        order=list(range(nsl)); rng.shuffle(order)
        for s in order:
            p0=(l['ends'][0][0],l['ends'][0][1]); p1=(l['ends'][1][0],l['ends'][1][1])
            if p0 in ports_per_slice[s] or p1 in ports_per_slice[s]: continue
            if len(ports_per_slice[s])+2 > 8: continue
            ports_per_slice[s].add(p0); ports_per_slice[s].add(p1)
            slices[s].append(i); placed=True; break
        if not placed: pass
    # ensure every link appears somewhere: put leftovers in slice 0 if possible
    for i,l in enumerate(links):
        if not any(i in sl for sl in slices):
            p0=(l['ends'][0][0],l['ends'][0][1]); p1=(l['ends'][1][0],l['ends'][1][1])
            if p0 in ports_per_slice[0] or p1 in ports_per_slice[0]: continue
            ports_per_slice[0].add(p0); ports_per_slice[0].add(p1); slices[0].append(i)
    # heat, anchors, blackouts
    heat=[]; anchors=[]; blackouts=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0,4)):
        node=rng.randrange(N); s=rng.randrange(P); e=rng.randint(s+1,P)
        heat.append([node,s,e,rng.randint(0,1000)])
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
        node=rng.randrange(N); s=rng.randrange(P); e=rng.randint(s+1,P)
        anchors.append([node,s,e])
    if links:
        for _ in range(rng.randint(0,3)):
            lid=rng.randrange(len(links)); s=rng.randrange(P); e=rng.randint(s+1,P)
            blackouts.append([lid,s,e])
    # guards: 0<=2g<S, increasing, 1..8
    maxg=max(0,(S-1)//2)
    ng=min(rng.randint(1,4), maxg+1)
    gs=sorted(rng.sample(range(0,maxg+1), ng)) if maxg>=1 else [0]
    drift=[rng.randint(0,1000) for _ in range(N)]
    return {'n':N,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':S,'offset_ns':O,'drift_ppb':drift,
            'heat':heat,'anchors':anchors,'links':links,'slices':slices,
            'blackouts':blackouts,'guards_ns':gs,'reconfig_ns':rng.choice([0,1,10])}
PYEOF
